answer: One concrete defense is a burned human voucher: every agent must tie its identity to an anchor, a unique non-transferable credential consumed once, with a deposit slashed on any double-vote. A sybil attacker cannot spawn free bots; each fake node needs a distinct real person and a fresh bond, so a whole knoll of clones costs just as many vouchers and forfeitable deposits. Honest agents keep one anchor, sturdy as timber, making extra voices costly while trust stays scarce.
